name: Enity Holding AB
summary: Established in 2004 and headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, Enity Holding AB provides mortgage lending services across Sweden, Norway, and Finland. The company is actively developing an innovative cloud-based operational framework to support a digital mortgage bank. It is characterized by its low-risk operational model, diverse funding sources, and sophisticated technology platform. Previously known as Bluestep Bank AB (publ), the company officially changed its name to Enity Holding AB (publ) in December 2024.
